title: Five faces: furniture rooms calibrated to the game (light tops, dark fronts)
why: faces-v3's made-up furniture had tops and fronts in the same shades; in the game, tops are light grey and fronts mostly black. Matching that should let tables and chairs transfer.
changes: Furniture rooms re-rendered: lit from above (fitted to the hand-made objects' shades), plain mid-grey table and chair tops (80%), fewer chair backs (10%)
Shade mismatch with real furniture down from 0.66 to 0.31 (0 = identical)
